verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents the search step well for agents. It offers an official MCP server so agents can call it as a web search tool, LLM-optimized markdown output across every API, and Google AI Mode scraping that returns Google's own synthesized answers. Nothing in the evidence shows extracting the contents of the result pages themselves, or a single API that chains search, extraction and synthesis. Missing for 10: page/URL content extraction, native synthesis or answer generation over extracted content, a documented end-to-end multi-step research endpoint, and hands-on corroboration of agent research flows.
